professionalSummary.text: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.

professionalSummary.text: Ran policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method, with workshop records capturing policy decisions including resolved disagreements within customer teams and customer sign-off on each record.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign-off on each workshop record.

professionalSummary.text: Loaded and reconciled customer employee data with the data migration team, with reconciliation reports signed by the customer's HR lead.
professionalSummary.witness: Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.

professionalSummary.text: Trained customers' HR administrators under the training plan, with go-live approval recorded on the go-live checklist as the implementation manager's responsibility and with the candidate's responsibilities documented on the checklist.
professionalSummary.witness: Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go-live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go-live checklist together with which checks were mine.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote limitation notes and hand-over conditions for each implementation in the hand-over pack to the support team.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each implementation in the hand-over pack to the support team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Two workshop records with customer sign-off, one reconciliation report, one go-live checklist with manager approval, and one hand-over pack with implementation tool references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two workshop records with the customers' sign-off, one reconciliation report, one go-live checklist with the manager's approval and one hand-over pack, with the implementation tool references as a verification trail.

evidence.text: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.

evidence.text: Interviewer 1 note: in the workshop exercise, when the two panel members playing the customer disagreed on the overtime policy, the candidate wrote both positions on the board, asked which payroll rule each would produce, showed the two resulting payslips, and recorded the decision the customer then made with the name of the decider.
evidence.notes: Example of resolving disagreements in a workshop.

evidence.text: Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of data loading and reconciliation.

evidence.text: Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go-live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go-live checklist together with which checks were mine.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of training and go-live approval process.

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each implementation in the hand-over pack to the support team.
